Aircraft.name: SB-9
Aircraft.Instructions:
SB-9 "Nightvision" by WhoTookCarter
Standard pitch, roll, yaw, throttle, brakes, and trim. VR-ready.
Control groups: 1 - Hatch 2 - Fuel Probe 3 - Bomb Bay (must be open to drop bombs) 4 - Missile Bay (must be open to launch missiles) 5 - Disarm (for formation flying and safe jettison) 6 - Jettison 7 - Eject 8 - Exterior Lights
